target: Browser-local learning workspace with recall and backup

contract.purpose: Help the owner learn Mac-local AI through one exercise, recorded reasoning, and delayed recall while retaining the full learning library.
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM turns local model-training experiments into measured, reproducible recipes for useful specialist language models.
contract.driftNote: Public lessons extend the existing learning library while personal answers remain browser-local.
contract.audience: Learners studying foundational and advanced Mac-local AI systems, including people who do not use an AI tutor.
contract.job: Resume one study session, preserve its evidence, complete recall, and keep portable backups.
contract.thesis: Choose among focused Session Desk, reading-led Lesson Notebook, and map-led Learning Atlas.
contract.system: A: existing dark Bricolage/Geist research bench, generous single-column sequence, teal action and coral repair. B: warm paper reading canvas, serif lesson hierarchy, ruled notes, green actions. C: dark blue map with compact sans headings, mono stage labels, teal current node and neutral future nodes. All include explicit text states.
contract.signature: A: read/try/explain/review sequence. B: calculation and explanation on a notebook page. C: current exercise pinned within the prerequisite map.
contract.risk: A can hide breadth: retain Library access. B can encourage passive reading: require exercise evidence. C can distract with breadth: pin one current session.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser test && pnpm --dir browser run build && pnpm --dir browser run size:check && bash evals/learning-roadmap-smoke.sh && bash evals/project-completion-smoke.sh

comprehension.reviewer: Independent screenshot, source, keyboard, and live-flow review at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels

answers.product: A public learning workspace for understanding language models and Mac-local post-training through exercises and delayed recall.
answers.audience: Learners who want a self-contained path through model foundations, post-training, evaluation, and local systems.
answers.value: Learn on the website, preserve work locally, and verify understanding through checkpoints rather than passive reading.
answers.mechanism: Read, work an exercise, explain it, self-review, complete module-specific recall at two and seven days, then continue through ten modules.
answers.proof: Versioned browser-local state, checkpoint history, module-specific recalls, tested backup import and export, and the retained public article and artifact library.
answers.nextAction: Start Module 1, record the first checkpoint, and continue to Module 2 while the first recalls remain scheduled.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated the visual choice, selected browser-only persistence with export/import, and required self-contained public lessons for learners who may not use AI chat. Session Desk was selected and implemented.

notes: Issue #151. Session Desk implemented with ten module-specific exercise and recall loops, five applied cases, browser-only persistence, safe backup import/export, telemetry isolation, and retained library routes. Final independent review found no material P0, P1, or P2 issues.
